thread:
Ellen: Heads up 
AtlasHealth requested a tiny pilot of an Optimize Toolkit: batching + caching + quant recs + eval-triggered alerts. They emphasized "no silent regressions" and want a scriptable gate for CI.

Marcus: Can we scope an API + CLI MVP only? No UI for now.

Ellen: Yes. MVP goal: recommendation API, `ri-optimize` cli (suggest/check), eval-alerts webhook, sample runbook.

Tao: Minimum acceptance criteria suggestion:
- integrate with Atlas + 1 internal app
- >=15% token cost drop on a target route OR p95 latency improve without >2% eval metric loss
- injected regression detected by eval-alerts with <15% FP rate
- recommendations available via API and CLI

Sam: Telemetry needed: route seq-length histogram, p50/p95 latency, token-cost estimate. Opt-in for PHI customers.

Ellen: Security: default = no user-prefix caching for channels marked PHI/PII. Require explicit opt-in + KMS confirmation.

Marcus: API sketch:
```
{ "route":"/summarize","profiles":[{"id":"latency","p95_ms":120,"cost_delta_pct":"-10"},{"id":"cost","p95_ms":260,"cost_delta_pct":"-22"}],"checks":["run-eval clinical_suite","smoke --staging --route /summarize"] }
```

Tao: Eval-alerts: run customer prompt suites nightly, diff score, webhook on threshold. Allow per-suite thresholds.

Sam: Resource ask: 2 infra engs + 1 infra-sre + 1 PM for ~6 weeks for API+CLI prototype.

PilotBot: Pilot ticket created: pilot-optimize-toolkit, assigned to Ellen.

Ellen: Next steps: Marcus/Tao draft acceptance doc + rollback steps (EOW). I'll schedule co-browse with Atlas once doc is ready.

Marcus: +1 to API+CLI first. UI later after usage patterns.

Tao: I'll scope telemetry changes with eng-infra tomorrow.

Sam: I'll prepare the smoke commands to include in the PRD.

Ellen: Thanks all — posting the doc when ready. :v:
